summary: Iteration 79 — full e2e verification of Radio DiscoverBrowse (web + mobile parity across /radio and mobile home tab), Merchant Earnings, and Merchant Subscribe. BACKEND (13/13 pytest — /app/test_reports/pytest/iter79.xml): GET /api/merchant/marketplace/earnings returns full owner-gated shape (business_id/memberships_sold/gross_cents/fee_cents/net_cents/month{count,gross,fee,net}/transactions[]) with net == gross - fee for both web test@ (cookie) and mobile demo@ (Bearer session_token); unauth → 401. GET /api/merchant/marketplace/subscription/plans returns exactly 3 tiers with correct pricing (starter 0¢, growth 2999¢, pro 9999¢) and can_offer_memberships flags (pro=True, growth/starter=False). GET /api/radio/browse?source=imported respects sort=popular/az/newest (AZ verified case-sensitive ASCII lexical order), language filter (english leak-tested), country=AE, and q= search; total+items+limit+counts_by_source correct. GET /api/radio/discover returns rails with facet_chips[{slug,label,count}] on ≥3 rails (languages/genres/countries). WEB (design=radiolife, cookie login test@bigfm.dubai/TestUser123!): /radio DiscoverBrowse (radio-browse-teaser) fully interactive — all 9 target testIDs (search, lang-chips, genre-chips, country-chips, sort-popular/az/newest, teaser-scroll, teaser-cta) OK; 24 cards on popular, first card changed after AZ sort re-fetch (imp_fun_talk_1003_uae → imp_89b63085db054c2b86), 24 LIVE badges + 3 HOT badges rendered; language chip 'english' filter worked; favourite heart tap added row to radio-browse-favorites rail. NOTE: clicking a teaser card navigates to the station page (opens house-sponsor pre-roll) — so radio-browse-recent rail only populates after returning; not a defect, just how mount works. /shop/merchant (NOT /shop/merchant/dashboard) is the correct dashboard URL — MerchantDashRadioLife renders and merchant-open-earnings tile navigates to /shop/merchant/earnings. Earnings page (rl-merchant-earnings-page) all target IDs (earnings-net-total/-sold/-month-net/-month-fee) present; earnings-tx-list ONLY renders when transactions.length > 0 (test@ has 0 sales — empty state 'No membership sales yet.' shown instead — correct branching). Subscribe page (rl-merchant-subscribe-page): plan-starter shows 'Free' + 'Start free' with subscribe-starter, plan-growth shows $29.99/month, plan-pro shows POPULAR + MEMBERSHIPS badges + $99.99/month + 'Current Plan' (test@ grandfathered). MOBILE (Expo web preview, demo-login-btn → demo@bigfm.dubai): HOME tab DiscoverBrowse with home-browse prefix — home-browse-teaser + search + sort-popular/az/newest + cta all present, 24 home-browse-card-*, 24 live + 3 hot, AZ sort re-orders (first card changed). RADIO tab DiscoverBrowse with radio-browse prefix — same 24 cards, single-line horizontal chip scrollers for language/genre/country all mounted, favourite tap works. Merchant Subscribe (/merchant/subscribe): plan-starter/growth/pro all rendered with $29.99/$99.99 decimals, Pro POPULAR + MEMBERSHIPS badges, 'Start free' text present, subscribe-pro button rendered (labeled 'Current Plan' since demo@ is on pro). Merchant Earnings (/merchant/earnings): real ledger — $17.99 net, $19.99 gross, $2.00 (10%) fee, 1 membership sold, earnings-tx-list shows '+$17.99' row. Dashboard (/merchant/dashboard) merchant-open-earnings tile taps through to earnings screen. Full web↔mobile parity confirmed. No blockers.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking a radio-browse-teaser-card navigates to the station page (with pre-roll house sponsor overlay) instead of playing inline within the /radio teaser context, so radio-browse-recent rail is not populated during that flow. Rail only appears after returning to /radio if playback was recorded elsewhere. Review spec expected 'playing a station adds to Recently played rail'. Confirm expected UX: inline play vs. navigate-then-play.

issues: Many station logos loaded over http:// (mixed-content warnings): tunein.com, radiofarda.com, mediamarkaz.com, trancebase.fm, 101smoothjazz.com, jazzradio.fr, radiocaroline.co.uk, lbc.co.uk, classicfm.com, yourclassical.org, 181.fm, deephouselounge.com, wonderful4dpro. Browser auto-upgrades to HTTPS but many hosts don't serve HTTPS → broken card thumbnails. Consider proxying logos via backend or falling back to placeholder on load-error.

earnings-tx-list container is not rendered when transactions=[] — testID becomes unaddressable in empty state. Consider always rendering the container with an empty <li>/empty-state child so automation can key off it. Alternatively add a stable data-testid='earnings-tx-empty' on the empty branch (present visually but no testID).

action_items: (Design nit — web) Empty-state on MerchantEarningsRadioLife.jsx:65-71 hides earnings-tx-list; add a data-testid='earnings-tx-empty' on the empty branch OR keep the earnings-tx-list container mounted always with an empty child so automation has a stable hook.

(Design nit — web) Radio card thumbnails frequently http:// → mixed-content; consider a backend image-proxy or onerror-fallback to placeholder in RadioHome BrowseTeaser card renderer (radio-browse-teaser-card-*).

(UX clarification — web) Confirm intended UX for radio-browse-teaser-card-* tap: currently navigates to the station page + shows pre-roll house-sponsor overlay before playing. If review-spec wanted inline play to populate radio-browse-recent, wire an inline play handler (like mobile) that records recents without leaving /radio.

(Optional) The web dashboard URL is /shop/merchant (RadioLifeOverlay.jsx:101), not /shop/merchant/dashboard. Consider adding a redirect from /shop/merchant/dashboard → /shop/merchant to avoid the 'Business not found' fall-through via ShopBusinessRadioLife when links use the wrong path.
critical_code_review_comments: RadioLifeOverlay.jsx: /shop/merchant/dashboard falls into the generic startsWith('/shop/') branch and hits ShopBusinessRadioLife which tries to load a business with id='dashboard' → 'Business not found.'. If any doc/link uses /shop/merchant/dashboard the user gets a broken screen. Add an explicit 'if (pathname === /shop/merchant/dashboard) return MerchantDashRadioLife' alongside the /shop/merchant mapping.

MerchantEarningsRadioLife.jsx:65 — earnings-tx-list container is conditional on transactions.length > 0. This means the target testID is unreachable in the empty state, breaking automation contracts that expect the container to always be present.

marketplace_subscription.py:80-102 (unchanged from iter78) free-tier branch still does not cancel a paid Stripe subscription on downgrade — merchants who Pro/Growth → Starter keep being billed. Already flagged in iter78; still not addressed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows — both platforms; only nits above

test_credentials: Web: test@bigfm.dubai / TestUser123! (grandfathered Pro, owns marketplace_profile but no membership sales in current DB → earnings $0). Mobile: demo-login-btn → demo@bigfm.dubai (owns Fun Pizza Kitchen; 1 real membership sale in ledger → $17.99 net / $2 fee / $19.99 gross).
seed_data_creation: None new. demo@'s 1 ledger row (from prior iterations) was still present in DB and validated the ledger UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has a comprehensive iter79 pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter79_review.py (13 tests) covering plans/earnings/browse/discover. Mobile demo user's POST /api/auth/demo returns 'session_token' (NOT 'token' or 'access_token') — the field name matters when writing curl/Bearer tests. Web dashboard path is /shop/merchant (not /dashboard). RadioHome BrowseTeaser 'radio-browse-recent' rail requires actual playback events; clicking a card currently navigates to station page + house-sponsor pre-roll instead of inline-playing. Empty-state on earnings hides earnings-tx-list container.
